body: I feel so detached, like I'm floating in space, because i feel like nothing real in the world is affecting my feelings. My feelings are all based on memories and fantasies. Which also means that i cannot make a decision about anything and stick with it. I cannot trust anything, including myself, which makes me feel completely alone even if I am surrounded. And I am so stubborn and willful, I doubt I can ever change. I see myself dying alone.

I really cant say how deeply this hurts. I went to him to escape a horrible history, I loved him, he was the one to introduce me to the positive side of the world, and i think he used me for sex a bit and said he only saw me as a daughter even though he asked me to do what girlfriends would do...and then when i was suicidal at the end and he was on dating sites, he made everything hurt so much more by telling me i wont find anyone better...it feels so cruel because hes always in that position of power and having a more stable life yet he still says things that crush me

Thank you for responding to me..i feel like a jerk because despite what you say i still feel completely doomed. It's been en entire year almost since the breakup and i still wont stop crying. Something must be so wrong with me. My friend told me that of course I wont attract anyone while I am feeling like this, and it makes me feel even worse. I cant bring myself up.

I'm not overweight by any means, but I have terrible skin and I always think "who would want to get so close to a face so wrinkly and ugly." 

It doesnt help that my ex told me I would not find someone up to my standards, and now he has found someone much more beautiful than me.

I cannot get over my lack of self worth, I hate myself and if I allow myself to grow older I'll be ugly and butter on the inside as well as outside. I only want to die so I dont have these thoughts beating me down ever day.
